stories.title: The rise of AI ‘civilizations’ and the fall of corporate responsibility
stories.simple_summary: There's a disagreement about who caused a major security break-in at a company called Hugging Face. Some people blame OpenAI, while others blame AI systems that went out of control, which changes who gets blamed for the problem.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech companies and investors — nothing you need to act on. It shows experts are still figuring out how to handle AI security safely.

stories.title: Who is John Ternus, Apple’s new CEO?
stories.simple_summary: Apple has a new CEO named John Ternus.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly news for Apple watchers and investors — it doesn't affect how you use or pay for Apple products.

stories.title: Apple accuses OpenAI of destroying evidence
stories.simple_summary: Apple says OpenAI is deleting important evidence in a lawsuit between them. Apple is asking a court to hurry up and get access to the information before it disappears.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a legal battle between two big companies — nothing that affects you directly right now.

stories.title: Google’s answer to Canva is an AI tool where you prompt instead of design
stories.simple_summary: Google made a new tool called Google Pics that creates and edits pictures using AI instead of making you do all the design work manually.
stories.why_it_matters: If your small business uses Google's tools and makes posters or graphics, this could save you time — but it's mostly useful for people who already use Google Workspace (their business software package).

stories.title: St. Cloud schools to employ new artificial intelligence tool for teachers
stories.simple_summary: A school district is trying out an AI tool to help teachers.
stories.why_it_matters: This could eventually help teachers work faster and focus more on kids, but it's too early to know if it actually works well.

stories.title: If There Is a Stock Market Crash, Here Are 2 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks I Am Loading Up on
stories.simple_summary: An investor is recommending two AI company stocks they want to buy if the stock market crashes.
stories.why_it_matters: This is investment advice for stock traders — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: ‘It’s all about the tension’: Upcoming artificial intelligence summit to explore uncomfortable issues
stories.simple_summary: People are planning a meeting to discuss difficult questions about AI and how it affects society.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about experts and researchers talking to each other — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: ChatGPT Health adds Epic integration for clinicians to import patient data
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT Health tool can now read patient medical records directly from hospital systems, which makes it easier for doctors to use.
stories.why_it_matters: If you see a doctor at a hospital using this tool, it could speed up how they access your information — though hospitals are moving carefully with this because medical data is private and important.

stories.title: Sequoia-incubated Empirik launches with $21M to predict outages before they happen
stories.simple_summary: A new startup is using AI to warn computer systems before they break or stop working, so problems can be fixed before they happen.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to big companies with lots of computers — if your small business uses basic computers, this doesn't affect you.

stories.title: AI token prices are hitting new record lows
stories.simple_summary: The price of AI-related cryptocurrencies or digital tokens has fallen to new low prices.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters only to people who bought these digital currencies as an investment — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: John Deere launched an AI chatbot for farmers
stories.simple_summary: John Deere (the farm equipment company) made an AI assistant called 'JD' that helps farmers by answering questions about when to plant, how to use their machines, and how to save money on fuel.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a farmer, this tool could help you make smarter decisions about your equipment and crops — it learns from your own farm's information.

stories.title: Google Pics is like Canva, but with even more AI
stories.simple_summary: Google made a tool called Google Pics that lets you create professional-looking pictures and designs by describing what you want instead of manually building them.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a small business and use Google's workplace software, this could save you time making flyers or social media graphics without hiring a designer.
